2.49.29
List.Sorting
Applies to RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01
The List.Sorting element specifies the expressions by which to sort repeated list regions. This
element is optional and is of type Sorting.
Following is the parent element of the List.Sorting element.
Parent elements
 List
The following is the XML Schema definition of the List.Sorting element.
 <xsd:element name="Sorting" type="SortingType" minOccurs="0" />
